form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.report_type_printed: Seven days preceding the Primary Election
reports.notes: Born-digital typed fillable form (index format 'text'). Office field reads 'Utah County Clerk' (index.csv 'County Clerk' - agrees). Page name reads 'Corey Astill'; index.csv carries 'Corey K Astill' (no middle initial on the page). Street address, phone number and signature are redacted upstream by the county; the printed city 'Lehi, UT 84043' and the email survive. ** BOXES B, C AND F ARE TRUNCATED BY THE FORM FIELD **: each is not a single amount but the compound string '112885.40 +Inkind 44821.9' followed by at least one more character that is CLIPPED at the right edge of the field box and cannot be read. The in-kind figure's final digit(s) are therefore NOT transcribable and were NOT inferred - the three fields are recorded exactly as far as the page renders them and carry LOW confidence for that reason. Boxes D, E and the close are clean single numbers. Observation offered without altering any value: the printed Balance at Close (23568.34) equals the cash figure 112885.40 minus Box D (89317.06), i.e. the filer's close uses the CASH contribution only and treats the in-kind as an annotation - this is an observation about the page, not a reconstruction of the clipped digits. Cover prints the filing address as 'disclosures@utahcounty.gov'.
